subject: Weekly situation report — sprint velocity, OKR deltas & QBR prep
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly situation report — sprint velocity, OKR deltas & QBR prep

Team — sending the compact situation report ahead of Monday's exec prep. I prioritized clarity for the QBR one-pager (attached) and called out the three asks where I need quick alignment. TL;DR: steady velocity, one external risk on benchmarking, and two decisions required for QBR slides.

Wins
- Serving runtime perf: steady 12% improvement in p95 latency vs last week after kernel tweak; this closes 60% of our performance gap for the demo scenarios.
- Customer traction: Acme pilot onboarded to Dedicated trial; first two jobs ran at target throughput.
- Obs & Alerts: New latency threshold rule deployed; mean-time-to-detect for high p50 dropped from 22m to 6m.

Risks / Open items
- Benchmark parity: third-party benchmark from Atlas returned anomalies on sequence-length heavy workloads (see platform-weekly-metrics.csv). Risk: if the anomaly holds, we will need a small rollback or targeted fallback for longer contexts in the demo.
- QBR narrative: need firm answers on cost delta vs last quarter for the Hosted API baseline. Finance has partial numbers; we must commit to the figure by Tuesday.

Asks (short)
1) Laura: confirm we sign off on the QBR cost delta number by Tue 11/16 EOD so slides can be locked.
2) Jonas: authorize a 24-hour capacity to run Atlas repro tests (SUP-4821) if I greenlight—will need your OK to use dedicated infra.
3) Marissa & Karthik: review the attached mutual-action-plan draft and mark any edits inline; final required by Fri 11/19 so legal can start the SOW.

Attachments: QBR_one-pager.pdf, platform-weekly-metrics.csv, mutual-action-plan-draft.docx

Thanks — Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:07:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly situation report — sprint velocity, OKR deltas & QBR prep

Thanks Michael — quick notes:
- QBR cost delta: finance gave me a provisional delta of +7.4% YoY (excluding one-offs). I will confirm the final by Mon morning; if that's acceptable for your slides, lock the narrative and we can footnote later.
- Atlas tests: I support running the repro on dedicated infra; please scope the job and include expected run-time and cost; tag it to SUP-4821.

Also, small ask: can we add a one-sentence customer success highlight to the one-pager (Acme onboarding success)? It helps exec narrative.

—Laura

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly situation report — sprint velocity, OKR deltas & QBR prep

Thanks — final status update before QBR slide freeze:
- Wins: I'm attaching a one-line CS highlight for the one-pager (Acme onboarding note) and have incorporated Laura's cost delta provisional.
- Risks: Atlas repro completed; anomaly appears related to a KV-cache edge case at >4k tokens. Jonas' team has a short-term patch; we will include the fallback plan on slide 4.
- Asks closed: Jonas authorized the repro (cost acknowledged), Laura confirmed the +7.4% figure for the narrative, Karthik and I finished a pass on the mutual-action-plan and uploaded comments to the Drive link. Legal kickoff is Monday.

Final asks left: minor slide wording approval from exec distro by Mon 11/22 10:00am PT. If no objections, I will freeze and hand the deck to comms.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
